title: Data‑variant copy swap for instant A/B testing (CSS‑only toggle)
knob:
Add two sibling elements for any copy you want to test, e.g.: ```html

Сайт за 2 дня – клиенты в Яндексе

Получите готовый сайт за 48 ч – первые заявки уже сегодня

``` Add CSS: ```css [data-variant] {display:none} [data-variant].show {display:block} ``` Add a 2‑line script at the end of ``: ```js const v = location.hash.replace('#','')||'a'; document.querySelectorAll('[data-variant]').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('show',el.dataset.variant===v)); ```
effect: Changing the URL hash to `#a` or `#b` instantly swaps copy without rebuilding or redeploying, enabling rapid A/B of headlines, sub‑headings, benefit lists, etc.
risk: Requires adding temporary markup; if left unchecked it may affect SEO (duplicate visible text).
rollback: Delete the added `[data-variant]` elements, CSS block, and script (single git revert or file edit).
verify: Open page, append `#a` or `#b` in address bar, observe which variant is visible; confirm only one is shown.
priority_claim: 2 – low‑cost way to test messaging variations before committing to design.
